results.title: Borealis cooling operations guide
results.text:
# Borealis cooling operations guide

Keep the pilot at 10% for 24 hours. If p95 latency exceeds 80 ms for ten minutes, pause expansion and investigate.

## Operator checklist

1. Check the 1,200-request audit sample.
2. Record the latency window.
3. Request human approval before expanding traffic.
